notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact, enchantment and/or token.
description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Farsight Ritual by paying {2}{U}{U} and sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token, causing you to look at the top eight cards of your library, put Approach of the Second Sun and any other card into your hand and put the rest on the bottom of your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.
